claim_results.claim: A people frozen in 1850, opting out of modern life because they cannot or will not keep up.
Run the equation on them and a different picture emerges.
We start with the architecture — the seven structural rules that keep the membrane intact — and the single axiom that generates them all. ---
It *artificially imposes* distance and friction so that interactions remain high-cost and therefore high-value.
It is banned because it dissolves the bond.
Conservative districts even regulate the *capacity* of solar arrays, because too much surplus power recreates the grid by other means.

The algorithm calls it a brilliant filter. *Owning* a car restructures time, budget, and identity — it produces a sovereign individual who can leave at will. *Hiring* a car is expensive, requires planning, involves a third party, and leaves the user a tethered community member who is temporarily borrowing speed.
The Amish do not look like the past because they were left behind.
They look like the past because they are running the only algorithm that has been empirically demonstrated to produce coherence at scale across multiple generations of accelerating entropy.
